blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — Two motorcycle riders were killed in a collision with a tricycle in Barangay Domanpot at Calasiao town on Sunday afternoon. The driver and back rider of a black Suzuki Raider 150 motorcycle (bearing plate number 583ACS) were traveling to Asingan town when they slid into the path of a red RUSI Macho 125 tricycle, driven by a 32-year-old driver, who was headed for Urdaneta City with two passengers. The two motorcycle riders were declared dead on arrival at the Asingan Community Hospital. READ: Family of 4 killed in Pangasinan highway crash The tricycle driver and his two passengers […]...
